task: ADR-037 (Design-Time Baseline Feedback Loop: Stage 7-8 -> Stage 16 -> Stage 6): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Decides a second, design-time feedback loop alongside the execution loop, capturing defects as BFI-NNN, reusing existing Stage 16 policies (classify-diff-type, escalate-diff-response) with evidence_basis: design_time, producing a Baseline Revision Package (patch increment PMP-BL-v1.0.x), keeping zero storage sprawl (ADR-002), no new TaskPolicy, and human approval throughout (ADR-001, ADR-007 Invariant 4).

Five alternatives evaluated and rejected with real reasons: keeping Stage 7-8 findings in Adaptation Plan, adding a new TaskPolicy, recording them as lessons learned, allowing Stage 17 with evidence_basis flag, and adding rows to ADR-007/008 without dedicated ADR.

Discloses benefits (defined home for design defects, approver sees full baseline, separable evidence, zero storage sprawl) and costs/risks (bookkeeping overhead, potential mislabeling of execution evidence, Steering Committee ceremony in small teams, deferred PMP generation until ADR-034 port).

Discloses open questions in Section 8 (BFI id scoping across cycles, ADR-013 patch increment threshold, repository approval limits, retro-logging, and downstream code story for evidence_basis in evaluate_governance_diff) and clarifies what is not decided.

evidence.source: direct_doc_read:docs/adr/ADR-037-design-time-baseline-feedback-loop.md; cross-checked against ADR-001, ADR-002, ADR-007, ADR-008, ADR-013; tested in Kayros Bay PROP-001
residual risk: evaluate_governance_diff code story not yet implemented (gated on ADR-037 acceptance)
